teaser: A ledger, closed, waits on the counter. You are a life path 8, an ISTJ, and the two of you do not need to be told what it means to carry weight. The 8 wants command of the material world; the ISTJ already holds a line so things function. The ambition does not announce itself here — it shows up as books that balance, a contract read twice before signing, a raise asked for in writing, with numbers attached. What is particular to this crossing is how little performance any of it needs. The 8 wants a podium. This version of the 8 checks the podium's foundation first.
excerpt: Folding a shirt the same way it has always been folded, hands moving before the thought finishes — that is often how care gets delivered here, in the form rather than the declaration.
